GPTR-F-001-S97.title: Azure Function API Enforcement Layer
GPTR-F-001-S97.description: Implement Azure Function endpoint wrapper that intercepts all GPTReader requests, applies schema validation and allowlist enforcement before invoking any MongoDB query logic.

GPTR-F-001-S98.title: Unit Test Coverage for Allowlist Enforcement
GPTR-F-001-S98.description: Create unit tests validating schema compliance, allowlist enforcement, and rejection paths for invalid collections, fields, operators, and malformed queries.

GPTR-F-001-S99.title: Integration Tests with GPTReader and Tool Router
GPTR-F-001-S99.description: Implement end-to-end tests ensuring that requests originating from tool_router pass through GPTReader enforcement and correctly block disallowed queries while allowing valid ones.

GPTR-F-001-S100.title: Audit Logging and Security Telemetry
GPTR-F-001-S100.description: Extend GPTReader logging to capture all enforcement decisions (allowed, rejected, reason codes) with audit-safe metadata for monitoring and security review.
